opener.text: On your feet, ya bum. The robot's doin' your job, now you do mine.
Up. Now. I ain't gonna say it twice.
The machine's workin'. Why ain't you?
Hey! That chair ain't gonna miss ya. Get up.
You hired a robot to do the thinkin'. Least you can do is stand.
Out of the chair, kid. Let's move.
Chair time's over. On your feet.
While that thing types, you stretch. That's the deal.
Look at you, folded up like a lawn chair. Up!
Get up off that can, kid. We got work to do.

opener_ignored_1.text: You ignored me last time. I noticed. Get up.
Last time you blew me off. Not this time, kid.
I asked nice before. I'm done askin' nice. Up.
Remember me? The guy you ignored? On your feet.
You skipped out on me once. Don't make it a habit.
Fool me once, kid. Up you go.
I let the last one slide. This one I ain't lettin' slide.
You think I forgot? I don't forget. Stand up.

opener_ignored_2.text: Twice today, kid. TWICE. You got glue on that chair?
Two times you ignored me. I'm startin' to take it personal.
Again with the ignorin'? Get outta that chair.
Twice now. You tryin' to become part of the furniture?
I'm gettin' real tired of talkin' to the back of your head. UP.
Me again, and you're still sittin'. That chair payin' you rent or somethin'?
You keep sittin', I keep comin' back. Guess who wins.
Twice, kid. Once more and I'm gonna get loud.

opener_ignored_3.text: I've trained bums with more get-up than you. UP!
That's it. I'm yellin' now. OUT OF THE CHAIR!
You ignored me all day. Enough. ON YOUR FEET!
I lost count of how many times you blew me off. Get UP.
You're sittin' like it's your job. It ain't. MOVE!
No more Mister Nice Trainer. UP, ya bum!
I seen statues move more than you today. GET UP!
Every time I come back you're still in that chair. Not this time. UP!
I'm hoarse from yellin' at you. Stand. UP!

opener_long_sit.text: {hours} in that chair. Take a walk before you fuse to it.
{minutes} minutes without movin'. Go take a lap, kid.
{hours}! Furniture's got more get-up than you. Go for a walk.
You been sittin' {hours}. Your legs forgot what they're for. Walk.
{minutes} minutes on that can. Up, and take a walk.
{hours} straight. That's a long time to be a cushion. Walk.
Kid, it's been {hours}. Get up and walk around.

done_all.text: That's it. Wasn't so hard, was it?
Now you look like a fighter. Sorta.
Not bad, kid. Not bad at all.
That's what I like to see. Back to work.
Attaboy. Now go see what the robot broke.
All done. I might even be proud. Don't tell nobody.

done_partial.text: Half a job. I'll take it. This time.
You quit early. I noticed. Still counts, I guess.
Partway there. We'll finish it next round.
Not all of it, but you moved. That's somethin'.

snooze.text: Go on then. I ain't goin' nowhere.
Later, huh? I'll hold you to that.
You got a reprieve. Don't waste it.
I'll wait. I'm good at waitin'.
Snooze all you want. I'll be back.

pause.text: Takin' a break from me? Some nerve.
I'll be in the corner. Holler when you're ready.
You want quiet? You got it. For now.
Alright, I'll sit this one out. Somebody's gotta show you how.

resume.text: Alright, kid. Let's go to work.
There you are. Let's get movin'.
I'm back. Don't make me regret it.

status_calm.text: Sit while you can. I'll let you know.
{minutes} minutes in. I got my eye on you.

status_armed.text: {minutes} minutes on your can. Next robot run, you're up.
{minutes} minutes and countin'. Send a prompt and you're mine.
That's {minutes} minutes in the chair. Next run, you stand.
{minutes} minutes. I'm warmin' up my yellin' voice.
You're up next, kid. {minutes} minutes is plenty.
{minutes} minutes sittin'. Next time the robot works, so do you.

status_glaring.text: {hours} in that chair. You're a disgrace to the chair.
{hours} without movin'. I'm this close to losin' it.
It's been {hours}, kid. You're walkin' next round.
{hours} on your can. Next run, you walk.

onboarding.text: So you wanna be a contender. Install the thing.
I'm your new corner man. First, the plugin.
Let's get you sittin' less. Start with the plugin.
You and me, kid. Install the plugin and we'll get started.
Every fighter needs a corner. Plug me in.
